sc: Newborn lost 8% of birth weight by day 3, feeding well → Physiological: reassure
Short and overweight, delayed bone age → Endocrine cause (hypothyroidism, GH deficiency)
Head crossing centiles upward, bulging fontanelle, sunset eyes → Hydrocephalus: cranial ultrasound
f: Birth weight doubles at 4–5 months, triples at 1 year · 1–6 yr: age × 2 + 8 kg
Length 50 cm at birth, 75 cm at 1 yr · 2–12 yr: age × 5 + 80 cm · < 4 cm/yr before puberty is abnormal
OFC 35 cm at birth, +12 cm in year 1 · anterior fontanelle closes 12–18 months; late: rickets, hypothyroidism
X-ray of the left hand and wrist · delayed: constitutional delay, hypothyroidism, GH deficiency · advanced: precocious puberty, CAH
SAM: MUAC < 11.5 cm or WFH < −3 SD or bilateral oedema · MAM: MUAC 11.5–12.4 cm
trap: Birth weight does not double by 1 year (it triples) · a child who stays on a low centile is growing normally: the curve, not one reading, matters · weight falls first in undernutrition, height later
